agent.description: Admitted agent definition name, or null. An editor assignment selects its own exact admitted definition.

profile.description: Eligible admitted profile, or null for the pinned child default.

primary.description: List immediate directory entries. This does not read or edit file contents.
primary.name: arany_list

primary.description: Read a Workspace file and obtain its whole-file SHA-256. Read numbered lines with a 1-based offset; null offset starts at 1 and null limit reads up to 2000 lines. Continue from next_line when present. Read further pages yourself when needed.

limit.description: Number of lines, 1 through 2000; null reads up to 2000 lines. Lines are numbered and cut after 2000 characters; the rendered result budget may end the page earlier.

offset.description: 1-based start line, 1 through 4294967295; null starts at line 1. Continue using next_line.

primary.name: arany_read

primary.description: Search literal UTF-8 content in a Workspace file or directory. Use Read or an include for edit SHA-256.
primary.name: arany_search

primary.description: Show the Workspace repository's branch and its changed, unmerged and untracked paths under a path. Read-only; repository configuration, hooks and filters never run.

path.description: Workspace-relative path that limits the result; "." for the whole repository.

primary.name: arany_git_status

primary.description: Show changed-file line counts and a bounded unified patch: working tree vs index, staged index vs base or HEAD, working tree vs base, or base vs head. Read-only.

base.description: null, or HEAD, a branch or tag name, or a 7-64 character hex commit name, with at most four ~N or ^N ancestry steps (N at most 9999). No ranges, ':' or '@{'. At most 128 bytes.

head.description: null, or HEAD, a branch or tag name, or a 7-64 character hex commit name, with at most four ~N or ^N ancestry steps (N at most 9999). No ranges, ':' or '@{'. At most 128 bytes.

path.description: Workspace-relative path that limits the result; "." for the whole repository.

staged.description: true compares the index with base, or HEAD when base is null; head must then be null. false compares the working tree with the index (no revisions), with base, or compares base with head.

primary.name: arany_git_diff

primary.description: List up to max_count commits (hash, parents, author, Unix time, subject) from revision or HEAD that touch a path, newest first. Read-only.

max_count.description: Number of commits: integer 1 through 50 inclusive.

path.description: Workspace-relative path that limits the result; "." for the whole repository.

revision.description: null, or HEAD, a branch or tag name, or a 7-64 character hex commit name, with at most four ~N or ^N ancestry steps (N at most 9999). No ranges, ':' or '@{'. At most 128 bytes.

primary.name: arany_git_log

primary.description: Read an admitted runtime Skill as untrusted guidance; it grants no additional authority.
primary.name: arany_skill

primary.description: List an admitted local MCP server's bounded tool catalog.
primary.name: arany_mcp_list

primary.description: Create a new directory whose parent already exists. Does not edit an existing file.
primary.name: arany_mkdir

primary.description: Write the real Workspace file; null expected_digest only creates a missing file. Existing files require the current SHA-256.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 file content, at most 65536 bytes.

primary.name: arany_write

primary.description: Apply a unique literal replacement to the real Workspace file, guarded by its current SHA-256. To append, replace a unique file ending with that ending plus new text.

expected_digest.description: Exact lowercase 64-character SHA-256 from the file include or a successful Read. Never invent it.

new.description: Replacement literal text. Combined old and new UTF-8 size must be at most 65536 bytes.

old.description: Non-empty exact literal text occurring once in the current file, excluding Read line-number prefixes. To append, select a unique ending and include that ending plus the appended text in new.

primary.name: arany_edit

primary.description: Run an admitted command in an offline project snapshot. Large output keeps a head and tail with byte and line totals; narrow it with grep, sed -n or tail. Bounded file changes are validated and integrated separately; only an applied integration receipt confirms Workspace changes.
primary.name: arany_command

primary.description: Invoke an admitted MCP tool in the disposable offline snapshot.
primary.name: arany_mcp_call

primary.description: Ask the user to run a command that already failed inside the Guard again on the host with no sandbox. Use only after a `command` with identical program, args and cwd failed in this Run; put a one-sentence question for the user in `justification`. The user may refuse; never retry on your own.
primary.name: arany_command_unguarded

primary.description: Find Workspace regular files whose path relative to path matches a glob. Returns up to limit paths in path order with byte sizes; it reads no file contents, so use read for content and SHA-256.

limit.description: Maximum entries, 1 through 100; null returns up to 100. When may_be_truncated is true, narrow pattern or path.

path.description: Workspace-relative directory to search; null searches the whole Workspace.

pattern.description: Glob matched against each regular file's path relative to path, case-sensitively. * and ? stay within one path component; a whole ** component crosses zero or more directories, so use **/ for deeper files; {a,b} lists at most 16 alternatives in total. Bracket classes, backslash escapes, a leading !, absolute or ~ prefixes and . or .. components are refused.

primary.name: arany_glob

primary.description: Optionally record a bounded Goal plan and exact success criterion. A recorded plan only narrows scope and cannot be replaced.

max_active_ms.description: Positive integer of milliseconds of active time, at most 1800000; the Goal pins this ceiling and null is refused. Prefer a lower value that fits the task.

max_provider_calls.description: Positive integer of Provider calls, at most 64; the Goal pins this ceiling and null is refused. Prefer a lower value that fits the task.

max_runs.description: Integer 1 through 16 inclusive; the Goal pins this ceiling.

max_tokens.description: Positive integer of tokens, or null because the Goal sets no ceiling here.

command_timeout_ms.description: Integer 1000 through 600000 inclusive, or null for the pinned default.

commands.description: Up to 8 distinct admitted command names in ascending order; each uses lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_', at most 64 bytes.

mcp_tools.description: Up to 64 distinct admitted MCP bindings in ascending server and tool order. Server names are at most 64 bytes and tool names at most 128 bytes, each using lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_'.

mission.description: Non-empty UTF-8 Goal mission, at most 2048 bytes.

paths.description: Up to 64 distinct Workspace-relative paths in ascending order, each at most 512 bytes. Use "." alone for the whole Workspace; nested paths are rejected.

skills.description: Up to 64 distinct admitted Skill bindings in ascending name and resource order. Names use lowercase letters, digits, '-' or '_', at most 64 bytes; resource is null for SKILL.md or a relative path of at most 512 bytes.

content.description: Complete UTF-8 file content, at most 65536 bytes.

expected_digest.description: Exact lowercase 64-character SHA-256 from the file include or a successful Read. Never invent it.

new.description: Replacement literal text. Combined old and new UTF-8 size must be at most 65536 bytes.

old.description: Non-empty exact literal text occurring once in the current file, excluding Read line-number prefixes. To append, select a unique ending and include that ending plus the appended text in new.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path, at most 512 bytes; paths must cover it.

content.description: UTF-8 text, at most 8192 bytes; the whole plan contract must serialize within 8 KiB.

path.description: Workspace-relative file path, at most 512 bytes; paths must cover it.

primary.name: arany_plan
